public_gates: M780 runs the pre-registered lower-alpha ladder on M773 broader corpus
M780 keeps alpha 0.2 as failed reference
M780 reports strict normal-retention and intervention-sensitivity metrics
M780 stratifies seed 77025/source_index 12 normal boundary source
M780 does not train mutate actor or residual parameters run PPO or promote

do not train actor or residual parameters

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs a pre-registered no-training lower-alpha ladder to decide whether residual intervention sensitivity can survive strict normal retention on the broader corpus
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: limited no-training alpha-feasibility diagnostic only; no repair, PPO, or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if implementation mutates actor or residual parameters
stop if implementation changes the alpha ladder
stop if implementation omits strict normal-retention metrics
stop if implementation claims promotion readiness
fallback_plan: if lower alpha passes strict normal retention and improves intervention sensitivity, audit as limited alpha-feasibility
if no lower alpha works, design explicit normal-margin retention or boundary-source repair
if lower alpha passes normal retention but loses sensitivity, redesign residual objective scale or target selection
if additional normal sources fail, pivot to source-balanced mining and normal-retention objective design
